exposure_convention: USD-valued holding of foreign currency: loss_t = -100 * diff(log(USD_per_foreign_currency)); signed_return_t = -loss_t
preprocessing_rules: Require strictly increasing unique dates and positive published quotes.
Remove unavailable quotes ('.' or empty) without interpolation; successive observed quotes may span weekends/holidays.
Invert DEXJPUS (yen per USD) to USD_per_yen = 1.0 / quote before taking log differences.
Retain all signed and exact-zero percentage log losses.

paper_pdf.citation: Shuo Li and Liuhua Peng, Time-Varying Tails: Estimation, Inference, and Risk Measurement, arXiv:2611.06005v1
